audit_findings.title: Pre-2021 OE may include the divested PMC business
audit_findings.mechanism: Changes the 2016-2020 OE observations used in the log-trend anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: We completed the spin-off of our Process & Motion Control platform ("PMC") on October 4, 2021 in the Spin-Off Transaction, and, accordingly, the results of operations and financial condition associated with PMC have been reclassified to discontinued operations for all periods presented.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates that PMC was divested and later filings recast presented operating results, but the record does not identify the source or perimeter of each 2016-2020 OE number. Therefore, inclusion of PMC is an unresolved possibility, not a demonstrated error. Five of the ten trend observations could be affected, but the resulting anchor effect cannot be established without the underlying calculations.
audit_findings.action: Trace each 2016-2020 OE numerator to continuing-operations statements excluding PMC; reconstruct or discard every observation that cannot be reconciled, then refit the log trend.

audit_findings.title: The trend mixes pre-Elkay earnings with the post-merger share claim
audit_findings.mechanism: Distorts the aggregate-dollar OE trend and resulting anchor while the per-share denominator represents the combined company.
audit_findings.evidence: On July 1, 2022, the Merger was completed following which we changed our name to “Zurn Elkay Water Solutions Corporation”.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated comparability error: 2016-2021 exclude Elkay, 2022 includes only the post-July merger period, and only 2023-2025 are full combined-company years. Thus seven of ten observations do not represent a full-year claim comparable with the current combined-company shares. Because the $212.5 million anchor drives every scenario's operating value, reconstructing the series is reasonably capable of materially changing the valuation, although the direction cannot be determined without Elkay pro-forma OE.
audit_findings.action: Build continuing-operations, pro-forma combined-company OE for 2016-2022 with merger-issued shares treated consistently, or rerun using only full post-merger years and disclose the reduced history.

audit_findings.title: FY2025 OE may retain a non-operating pension settlement gain
audit_findings.magnitude: $10.0 million pre-tax and $8.0 million after tax; computed approximately $2.5 million of anchor and $0.21 per share of base-value effect
audit_findings.mechanism: Potentially inflates 2025 OE and, through that observation, the fitted log-trend anchor.
audit_findings.evidence: As a result, Pension Plan liabilities were settled and the Pension Plan was exited during the quarter ended September 30, 2025, resulting in a pre-tax settlement gain of $ 10.0 million from accumulated other comprehensive loss to other income (expense), net in the consolidated statements of operations.
audit_findings.explanation: Whether the gain was removed remains unresolved. If the full filed $8.0 million after-tax gain were removed from 2025 OE, the supplied ten-year log-trend mechanics imply an anchor reduction of approximately $2.5 million and a base equity-value reduction of about $35 million, or $0.21 per share. Base value would remain approximately $19.45 versus the $47.61 market price, so this item cannot change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Verify the 2025 OE reconciliation removes both the $10.0 million settlement gain and its filed $2.0 million tax effect; correct the series if necessary.

audit_findings.title: Cash-flow inputs are not separated from discontinued operations
audit_findings.mechanism: May contaminate OE through working-capital changes, capital spending, accrual movements or other cash-flow inputs while earnings use continuing operations.
audit_findings.evidence: The consolidated statements of cash flows for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023 have not been adjusted to separately disclose cash flows related to the discontinued operations.
audit_findings.explanation: The filings demonstrate that consolidated cash flows were not separated, but they do not establish which reported cash-flow lines entered the OE calculations or the cash amount attributable to PMC. Accrual releases could overstate OE while settlements or wind-down spending could understate it. The affected amount and resulting anchor impact therefore remain unquantified.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile every 2023-2025 cash-flow-derived OE input to continuing operations, identifying PMC accrual releases, settlements, capital spending and working-capital movements; rerun OE and the anchor after removing them.

audit_findings.title: Restructuring is recurring rather than safely excludable
audit_findings.magnitude: $38.4 million pre-tax for 2023-2025; $12.8 million annual average, equal to 6.0% of the $212.5 million anchor
audit_findings.mechanism: Improper add-backs would overstate historical OE, the normalized anchor and all scenario operating values.
audit_findings.evidence: Management expects to continue executing similar initiatives to optimize its operating margin and manufacturing footprint.
audit_findings.explanation: The filing demonstrates recurring charges of $15.3 million, $13.5 million and $9.6 million in 2023-2025, plus $2.7 million in the first half of 2026. Whether OE excluded them is not shown. Even treating the full $12.8 million pre-tax annual average as a dollar-for-dollar anchor overstatement is a conservative 6.0% bound; correcting it would only lower values already far below the $47.61 market price and therefore would not change the conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Inspect all OE adjustments for restructuring, severance, impairment, lease termination and facility rationalization; reverse improper add-backs or substitute a normalized recurring burden.

audit_findings.title: An underfunded pension claim may be absent from the equity bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $2.6 million, computed approximately $0.02 per share and 0.08% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: Would enter as a deduction from the equity bridge unless required catch-up funding is already included in projected OE.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, the Company had pension plans with a combined projected benefit obligation of $ 5.7 million compared to plan assets of $ 3.1 million, resulting in an under-funded status of $ 2.6 million compared to an under-funded status of $ 7.6 million at December 31, 2024.
audit_findings.explanation: The filed December 2025 pension deficit is $2.6 million. If entirely omitted from both OE and the bridge, deducting it would reduce value by only approximately $0.015 per share, rounded to $0.02, compared with base value of $19.66 and market price of $47.61. This cannot change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Confirm the pension-only funded status at June 30, 2026 and whether required contributions are embedded in OE; otherwise deduct the verified deficit from the equity bridge.
